Shader.Name: tom/MainOpaqueX
Shader.Tooltip: KKS Toon-first X material. Body, direct specular and environment reflection are independently controlled. Accepted Stage Two material baseline.

Shader.Property: RGB supplies body color; alpha multiplied by AlphaMask R supplies cutoff. Does not encode roughness.
Unity-imported tangent-space normal map. Affects lighting and reflection direction; use normal-map import, not color data.
Detail tangent-space normal combined with the main normal. MatCap can select a different normal source.
Linear R channel multiplied by MainTex alpha. This is cutout, not semi-transparent blending.
Optional linear packed map: R metallic, G roughness, B AO, A direct specular mask. Enabled by UsePackedMaterialMap.
Linear RGBA masks: R secondary tone, G Rim, B MatCap, A environment reflection. White enables each layer.
Multiplies MainTex RGB. For metals this also colors F0; not a promise of unchanged diffuse color at Metallic 1.
Strength of the main tangent-space normal perturbation.
Strength of the detail tangent-space normal perturbation.
Discard when MainTex alpha times AlphaMask R is below this value. Shared by body, outline and shadow.
0 double-sided; 1 render back faces; 2 render front faces. ShadowCaster follows the same material face policy.
Texture-mode direct Toon transfer. Linear R is sampled horizontally at V=0.5. Ignored in procedural mode.
Optional secondary direct Toon transfer, sampled from R. Blended by SecondaryToneStrength times LayerMask R.
Enable Toon transfer for direct diffuse. Disabling it uses continuous diffuse; does not disable physical shadows.
0 procedural Toon transfer; 1 RampTex R. Secondary tone can modify either source.
Direct diffuse light/shade boundary in procedural mode. Not a shadow-map bias.
Width of the procedural direct Toon transition. Smaller gives a harder boundary.
Procedural ramp dark-end value. Does not create unshadowed light behind an occluder.
Blend toward SecondaryRamp, masked by LayerMask R. No legacy Fresnel coupling.
Include artistic shadow visibility in the direct ramp input. Visibility is also retained outside the ramp.
Tint of the Base indirect body in main-light shadow. Does not tint every additional light separately.
Strength of main-shadow tint and direct diffuse shadow response. 0 relaxes artistic shadowing; 1 retains it.
Blend physical visibility toward the threshold/softness-shaped shadow response.
Boundary for optional shadow shaping; not geometry offset or light bias.
Transition width of optional shadow shaping.
Fallback material ambient color when LightProbeBlend is 0. Not reflection-probe brightness.
Main realtime direct diffuse and specular gain. Baked Subtractive main light remains owned by the lightmap.
Per-pixel ForwardAdd direct diffuse and specular gain. More lights still add energy.
Low-cost vertex diffuse fill gain. Vertex lights have no GGX, cookie or realtime shadow.
Blend fallback AmbientColor toward native SH/GI when not lightmapped. Does not control Reflection Probes.
Blend toward an available custom local SH volume. No effect without its external provider.
Indirect body illumination gain. Does not control direct lights or environment specular.
Blend continuous indirect irradiance toward separate Toon shaping. Independent of the direct ramp.
Luminance threshold for indirect Toon shaping.
Transition width for indirect Toon shaping.
Dark-level output of indirect Toon shaping; near-zero irradiance still fades to black.
Advanced ShadowCaster raster slope offset. Default 0. Unity Light Bias and Normal Bias remain separate.
Advanced ShadowCaster raster depth offset. Default 0. Excessive offsets detach shadows.
Use MaterialMap RGBA instead of separate metallic, roughness, AO and direct specular-mask textures.
Linear R multiplier for Metallic. Ignored when the packed material map is enabled.
Linear R multiplier for Roughness, then RoughnessBias is added. Ignored in packed mode.
Linear R ambient occlusion; white is unoccluded. Affects indirect layers, not direct light. Ignored in packed mode.
Metal fraction. Removes diffuse and moves F0 toward base color; not an artistic reflection-strength slider.
Physical perceptual roughness. Controls continuous GGX and, optionally, reflection-probe blur. Toon highlight size is separate.
Offset after roughness map multiplication. Physical roughness is clamped to at least 0.04.
Advanced dielectric IOR converted to F0. Default 1.5. At Physical Diffuse Suppression 0 it does not suppress body diffuse.
Direct-specular Fresnel gain and optional diffuse energy suppression. Environment Fresnel and Rim are separate.
0 preserves Toon diffuse independently of Fresnel; 1 applies physical Fresnel suppression. Metallic always removes diffuse.
Fade near the geometric light horizon to reduce normal-map back-light leaks.
AO influence on indirect diffuse; also supplies AO to optional specular occlusion.
AO influence on environment reflection only. Does not darken direct specular.
Linear R direct-specular mask. Does not mask environment reflection, MatCap or Rim. Ignored in packed mode.
Direct-light specular tint only. Environment reflection has its own tint.
Direct-light specular gain only. Does not change the environment reflection layer.
Direct-specular shadow visibility influence. 1 respects occlusion; lowering it deliberately relaxes shadowing.
0 continuous production GGX; 1 normalized GGX-shaped Toon highlight. No Legacy Blinn path.
Artistic Toon highlight size. Separate from physical roughness; used by the stylized endpoint.
Threshold of normalized GGX highlight shape before multiplication by light intensity.
Softness of the direct Toon highlight boundary, with derivative-based anti-aliasing.
1 smooth Toon highlight; 2-4 quantize its transition into bands.
Normal-variance roughness filtering and Toon edge anti-aliasing. Does not eliminate every temporal aliasing source.
0 off; 1 MatCap; 2 environment; 3 both. Their intensities and masks remain independent.
Linear R shared reflection-region mask, multiplied by LayerMask B for MatCap or A for environment.
Environment reflection gain, evaluated once in Base. Does not change indirect diffuse.
Probe blur when UseMaterialRoughnessForEnvironment is 0.
1 uses mapped material roughness for probe blur; 0 uses EnvironmentRoughness.
Main-shadow influence on additive MatCap and environment. Multiply MatCap stays identical across Base/Add.
0 continuous HDR environment response; 1 bright-region-selected Toon response. Uniform environments cannot supply local bright features.
Luminance boundary for selecting environment highlights after Selection Exposure.
Softness of environment bright-region selection.
Scales luminance used for highlight selection; does not scale body ambient illumination.
In the Toon environment path, 0 neutralizes environment hue and 1 retains it.
Optional base-color tint of environment reflection. Metal F0 is already colored; high values can double-tint metals.
Environment-only angular Fresnel influence. Separate from artistic Rim and direct specular Fresnel.
Tint of both continuous and Toon environment reflection.
View-normal sampled color texture. Multiply uses twice the sampled color, so mid-gray is neutral; Add adds sampled color.
0 multiply diffuse only in Base and Add; 1 add once in Base. Never multiplies direct specular, environment, Rim or emission.
Multiply tint blend amount or additive gain, masked by ReflectionMask R and LayerMask B.
Explicit MatCap mip level. Requires an imported mip chain to blur.
0 geometric normal; 1 main normal; 2 main plus detail normal. Lighting keeps its own combined normal.
Independent artistic rim tint.
Artistic rim gain, masked by LayerMask G. 0 disables Rim.
Main-shadow influence on Rim. Not additional-light shadowing.
Facing-angle extent of the rim. Independent of environment Fresnel.
Softness of the rim boundary.
0 view-only rim; 1 gates it by main-light geometric facing.
Linear R outline-width multiplier, vertex sampled.
Enable the inverted-hull outline. Layer debug views hide it.
Outline color.
Screen-space pixel-like width or world-space expansion using the shader scale convention.
1 screen-space width; 0 world-space expansion along normalized world normals.
Outline depth adjustment; positive moves away from the camera, accounting for reversed Z.
0 mesh normal; 1 normalized raw object-space normal in UV4.xyz. A zero UV4 vector falls back to mesh normal.
RGB emission mask, multiplied by EmissionColor and EmissionIntensity.
Emission tint, composed after the lighting layers.
Emission gain. 0 disables emission texture sampling.
1 multiplies emission by the evaluated base color; 0 leaves emission independent.
0 final; 1 body; 2 direct specular; 3 environment; 4 MatCap; 5 Rim; 6 emission. Fog and outline are hidden in layer views.
